Microsoft ranked 785 jobs by how much their work overlaps with AI. Can you guess #1?

The top 10, from #10: mathematicians, political scientists, telemarketers, customer service reps, broadcast announcers and radio DJs, CNC tool programmers, services sales reps, writers and authors, historians, and at #1, interpreters and translators. Software developers come 120th.

instagram.caption:
Is a computer science degree cooked?

Recent CS grads (ages 22 to 27) had the 4th-highest unemployment rate of 73 majors in 2024: 7.0%, against 4.2% for all recent grads. Higher than art history, English and philosophy.

But only 19% of CS grads work in jobs that don’t need a degree (all recent grads: 39%), and US software developer jobs are projected to grow 10% from 2025 to 2035 (the average job: 3%).

Our read: not cooked, but harder to get into. So don’t just collect the degree. Build proof: ship one real project a month, get good at checking AI’s code, and test a direction next to yours.

Comment your degree. We’ll reply with its NY Fed numbers.
